'''Business and economy'''
*[[Google]] lays off hundreds of employees in its core engineering team, and others working on [[Google Assistant]] and Google's hardware products. [https://www.nytimes.com/2024/01/11/technology/google-layoffs.html (''The New York Times'')]
*The [[United States Labor Department]] reports that auto insurance premiums experienced a remarkable rise in 2023, their highest annual increase in nearly half a century. [https://www.reuters.com/markets/us/remarkable-surge-auto-insurance-costs-fans-us-inflation-2024-01-11/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*A chartered [[Air Côte d'Ivoire]] flight from [[The Gambia]] to the [[Ivory Coast]], transporting the [[Gambia national football team]] to the [[2023 Africa Cup of Nations]], makes an emergency landing in [[Banjul]], Gambia, due to a [[Cabin depressurization|loss of cabin pressure]] lasting for more than nine minutes. All passengers suffer some degree of [[hypoxia (medicine)|hypoxia]] including [[Unconsciousness|loss of consciousness]]. [https://www.hindustantimes.com/sports/football/africa-cup-of-nations-gambia-football-team-makes-emergency-landing-after-plane-loses-oxygen-flying-101704982320266-amp.html (''Hindustan Times'')] [https://amp.theguardian.com/football/2024/jan/11/gambia-team-forced-to-make-emergency-landing-on-way-to-africa-cup-of-nations (''The Guardian'')]

**[[Latvia]] bans the sale and use of [[tobacco]] and [[nicotine]] products for those under the age of 20 years, beginning on January 1, 2025. [https://www.err.ee/1609218729/2025-aastast-alates-ei-tohi-alla-20-aastased-latlased-suitsetada (ERR)]
*[[South Africa v. Israel (Genocide Convention)|''South Africa v. Israel'']]
**A two-day public hearing begins at the [[Peace Palace]] in [[The Hague]], [[Netherlands]], regarding alleged [[Israeli war crimes|violations by Israel]] of its obligations under the [[Genocide Convention|1948 Genocide Convention]] and [[international law]] in relation to [[Palestinians]] in the [[Gaza Strip]]. '''Politics and elections'''
*[[2023 Guatemalan general election]]
**Former [[Ministry of the Interior (Guatemala)|Minister of the Interior]] Napoleón Barrientos is arrested for failing to comply with his duties for not using force to evict the blockades and demonstrations that occurred in October, which called for the resignation of Attorney General [[María Consuelo Porras]]. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/2024/01/11/guatemala-arrest-barrientos-election-bernardo-arevalo-porras/f2de96ce-b0a5-11ee-9a32-5c9e6aa28b3b_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]
**The [[Attorney General of Guatemala|Public Ministry]] orders the arrest of four magistrates of the [[Supreme Electoral Tribunal (Guatemala)|Supreme Electoral Tribunal]] who have been living in exile since losing their immunity in November. [https://www.prensalibre.com/guatemala/elecciones-generales-guatemala-2023/giran-ordenes-de-captura-contra-cuatro-magistrados-titulares-del-tse-por-la-compra-del-sistema-trep-breaking/ (''Prensa Libre'')]
**Vice President-elect [[Karin Herrera]] presents a legal appeal before the [[Constitutional Court of Guatemala|Constitutional Court]] due to the risk of a possible arrest warrant against her which would violate her immunity.
